steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Team Alpha, drop the supplies in the east-side clearing.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Set up medical tents in conjunction with the Paleroche reinforcements and be ready to receive wounded.

steps.name: Rescuer A
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Team Bravo, take your shovels and wineskins and look for survivors in the ruins of the train station. Be thorough and keep your ears open for any cries.

steps.name: Rescuer B
steps.text: Alright! Team, grab your gear and follow me—

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Try not to make too much noise. We could still be looking at a second avalanche. A team is on its way to investigate the mountains.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Trust our people, and trust in Kjeragandr's protection.

steps.name: Rescuer B
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Rescuer A
steps.text: ...By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: By Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Time's a-wasting. Get moving.

steps.name: Rescuers
steps.text: Yes, sir!
Before the voices disperse on the cold wind, the servants of Clan Silverash are already on the move, spreading out on the snow in every direction.
They are not the only ones here. The white tide has torn a gash in the peace.

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: Over here! This one's alive!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hang in there! You're a son of Kjerag, you can take it!

steps.name: Injured Man
steps.text: M-My leg...

steps.name: Injured Man
steps.text: I can't move my leg... my leg is... argh!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Don't move! Somebody in the back, report!

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: We dug a hole, but his leg is pinned under a steel girder. If we can't get it out of the way, we'll need a surgeon to... no, I'll try to dig it open a little bit more!

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: Grr—okay! Good news, the girder's already broken! All we need to do is lift it up!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: All we need is a little elbow grease! Over here, all hands on deck!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hold tight, one, two, three...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: —Hrragh!!

steps.name: Injured Man
steps.text: Argh... it hurts...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We got a gap! Pull him out now!

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: I got him. Take it easy, lift him up and put him on the tarp. Careful not to pull the wound open...

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: Slowly, carefully—

steps.name: Rescuer
steps.text: Got it! Stretcher!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic
steps.text: Out of the way! Stretcher coming through!
Suppressed, restrained cries. Rescues. Stretchers. Survivors.
The rescuers run back and forth on the white snow, their faces red with exertion, hot sweat dripping on the snow.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Take over for me here, Gulo. Save every soul you can.

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: But where are you going, sir?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir Arctosz... is rescue work in the south already done?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: No, not yet.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Gulo's overseeing it. I came to find you.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: We're handling things here, no need to worry. The Browntails' help has already arrived, they brought blankets and food.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Madame Ratatos wanted to come personally, but she seems to be otherwise engaged.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: ...I figured as much.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We know what's going on. Nobody blames her.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Schiisdräck! The timing of this bloody disaster!

spans.text: The timing of this bloody disaster!

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It came out of the blue. There were no warning signs, no chance to prepare.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yes! That's why I came to you.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You know the rules. This avalanche happened on Paleroche land, and we're responsible for the mountains here.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: We've been watching the thickness of the snowpack. I've seen the records myself. Everything was normal!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's why I came to ask. Don't you have people at that research institute of yours whose job is to check on the mountains? What are they saying?

spans.text: That's why I came to ask. Don't you have people at that
of yours whose job is to check on the mountains? What are they saying?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Research institute... you mean Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Yeah! They spend all day on the mountains carrying all that newfangled gear. You're not telling me they didn't find anything, are you?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: They have their own projects to deal with, and they don't necessarily focus all their attention on the mountains.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Besides, we came as soon as we heard about the avalanche. We haven't had a chance to find out what they know.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir Enciodes sent Degenbrecher up the mountains with a team. They should be back soon.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: This is sending chills up my spine. What in blazes is this avalanche...?
The wind wails, carrying snowflakes with it. The man turns around and stares at the mountain. He may be a mountain among men, but he is little more than a pebble before the silent mountains.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Is that...?
A group is moving quickly down the snowy mountain path, heading for the two men.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Sir Matterhorn!

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: We must let Sir Enciodes know at once! W-We found—
The investigator's expression is deathly pale, his fur boots wet and gray with dirty snow.
In the wind, his rapid and ragged breathing sounds almost like wailing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If there are no further questions about the framework agreement, let us now move on to the detailed terms of the agreement.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: First, concerning taxation of the joint Kjerag-Kazimierz mining endeavor—

steps.name: Karlan Trade Clerk
steps.text: (Whisper) Sir, Madam Degenbrecher is outside. She has something to report.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...Right now?

steps.name: Karlan Trade Clerk
steps.text: (Whisper) Yes. She says it's extremely urgent...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What's this urgent matter?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: We found this on the mountain where the avalanche occurred.
Degenbrecher opens her gloved hand, and a small, black shard of Originium lies quietly in her palm.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: On a mountain in Kjerag?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If the mountain by the train station counts as Kjerag.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Both Gnosis and Rhodes Island's have examined it. It's almost certain that...
Degenbrecher looks around her, making sure there are no eavesdroppers, and drops her voice.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: This avalanche was a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: How many know?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The investigation team is our people, so we can keep them quiet, but a number of those at the foot of the mountain have been infected.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It won't be a secret for long.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Instruct Matterhorn to set up a blockade and not allow civilians to approach. I want checkpoints on the mountains as well.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Contact Rhodes Island and request secrecy in the housing and treatment of patients. Tell them to contact Karlan Trade if they need any help.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And tell Ratatos and Arctosz to meet me at the train station in one hour. Whatever it takes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Understood. Anything else?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...Take a squad and go to Vine-Bead Court immediately.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And tell Gnosis to take a team to protect the Rhine Lab observation station.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Understood.
Enciodes checks his clothes and goes back into the conference room.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I apologize for the delay. Let us continue.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: First, concerning taxation of the joint Kjerag-Kazimierz mining endeavor...

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: Preposterous... preposterous!

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: There has never been such a prophecy in any of the scriptures. Why would Kjeragandr punish us with a Catastrophe? It's preposterous!

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: But it happened! She has left us because She is angry with us!

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: How do we explain this Catastrophe, if not by Kjeragandr's anger?

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: Look at the crowd surrounding the Vine-Bead Court now. They are pious believers in Kjeragandr, gentle children of Kjerag.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: Are we to tell them that the families and friends they lost, all their suffering, happened for no reason at all?

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: The people are troubled. Their faith is shaken... but it is at times like this that our own faith must be stronger than ever.

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: How do we know this isn't a trial from Kjeragandr to reinforce our faith?

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: Kjeragandr has not abandoned Kjerag... why would She punish Kjerag for no reason?

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: Perhaps it happened because we've acted against Kjeragandr's will—
The young cleric takes one look at the Saintess in the middle of the hall, then lowers his head without a word.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You may speak your mind.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: Saintess...

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: I believe this is the fury of Kjeragandr... it's a warning...

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: Because the Vine-Bead Court... because we made the wrong choice.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: We should not have allowed the faithless to build upon Mount Karlan. We should have remained firm, rejected them...

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: If they did not defile the temple of Kjeragandr and anger Her, why would Kjerag...?
His voice grows lower, but at the same time firmer. The hall is quiet, with no one speaking out in objection.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You believe that I, the Saintess, have offended Kjeragandr and brought Catastrophe upon Kjerag.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: N-No, Saintess, what I mean is...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No, your words offer valuable insight. It is not only the people at the foot of the mountain; many who sit among us think the same way.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: This is what is happening now. People doubt the Vine-Bead Court, and you, too, are anxious and wavering.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Cleric Fangot, Cleric Ronoa. One of you believes that Kjeragandr continues to favor us as She always has. The other believes that Kjeragandr has...
She bows and thinks for a moment, her alabaster face calm as ice.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Recite to me the Three Protections detailed in the Kjeragandr.

spans.text: Recite to me the Three Protections detailed in the

steps.name: Clerics
steps.text: ...Yes, Saintess.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: The First Protection, Page 7, Line 9 of the Kjeragandr.

spans.text: The First Protection, Page 7, Line 9 of the

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'And so She spoke to the shepherd boy, saying—'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'I shall grant you shelter, and all that you may need.'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'I shall hunt in the woods, and I shall plant seeds in the earth, such that you will have furs to wear and food to eat, and neither frost nor famine shall take you.'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'And thus, She protects us from the harms of cold and hunger.'

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: The Second Protection, Page 25, Line 17 of the Kjeragandr.

spans.text: The Second Protection, Page 25, Line 17 of the

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: 'And so the protector came forth from the people, awakened in the clouds of myriad colors, and built high walls of earth watered with snow.'

steps.name: Old Cleric
steps.text: 'And thus, She protects our homes and our kin, and She taught us the means to defend ourselves from our enemies.'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: And... Page 32, Line 2 of the Kjeragandr, towards the end.

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'That day, She proclaimed to the people:'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'My eyes shall watch over you, my fur shall warm you, my backbone shall protect you, while my flesh and blood shall bless you.'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'You have learned the way of wind and snow, and learned the form of walking.'

steps.name: Excited Cleric
steps.text: 'You are the people of Kjerag, and the land of Kjerag belongs to you from this day forth.'

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Very good...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Now tell me... is there anywhere in the Kjeragandr where Kjeragandr promises that Kjerag will always be safe from Catastrophe?

spans.text: Now tell me... is there anywhere in the
where Kjeragandr promises that Kjerag will always be safe from Catastrophe?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Are you making that promise to Kjeragandr's people on Her behalf?
Many of the seated clerics look down without a word.
It is quiet enough to hear a pin drop. The smell of incense fills the nostrils, but it feels as though their breaths have been frozen in place by the exchange that just occurred.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Elder
steps.text: Your words ring true, Saintess.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Elder
steps.text: Catastrophe has struck Kjerag. Some have died, and others have become afflicted.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Elder
steps.text: The entire Snow Realm has heard the news. Fear, anxiety, sorrow, and even anger, are spreading throughout the people of Kjerag.

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Elder
steps.text: Our duty is to seek a solution.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Certainly. Now is not the time for debate, and my words are intended as a warning, not to fall into the twin traps of panic and prejudice.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You are the faithful devotees of Kjeragandr, and you understand the weight that words have. No member of the Vine-Bead Court is to speak of 'Kjeragandr's punishment' from this moment forth.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Tomorrow, I will go into the Hall of Writings, and devote myself to studying the scriptures and hearing Her voice.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Elder Adso.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Yes, Saintess.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As the new Great Elder, you shall oversee the Vine-Bead Court in my stead, during my retreat.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You are to carry out the duties of the court faithfully and diligently, from placating the people to conducting the memorial service and copying the scriptures for the repose of the deceased.

steps.name: Adso
steps.text: Understood...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We must have faith...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...Kjerag has weathered many storms and overcome many challenges. The Vine-Bead Court is ever with the people.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: At least things haven't gotten out of hand...
The girl exhales and slumps over the desk, finally able to relax the back that she has kept straight as a fir in the snow.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I don't understand. Why do people keep treating our god as a wishing well? Why do they attribute everything good and bad in their lives to Her?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I know, this is not how I should think, as their Saintess, but...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But I don't understand why a Catastrophe would strike now, either.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Bring in the dressers, please, Kjarr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The funeral preparations are done. Starting tomorrow, we'll...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr?
The room is quiet except for the whistling of the wind and the cracking of the fire.
Enya turns to find that the room is completely empty.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr... where are you?
The handmaiden who should be at the Saintess's side at all times is nowhere to be seen. There is only Enya's own shadow, thin and long in the light of the fireplace, flickering in the dim room.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr...?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Enya...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Tell me... honestly...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Do you still... hear Kjeragandr's voice?
The cracking of burning firewood echoes through the empty room.
The wind continues to wail outside the window. She can almost hear the cries of the bewildered devotees at the foot of Mount Karlan.
Enya recalls the day that she first came to the Saintess's quarters.
An unfamiliar room, an unfamiliar smell. Home was well in sight, yet she would never return there under her own name. At that time, she felt the same emptiness, as though this room were a snowy cave.
But she has grown accustomed to having a companion, someone to whom she can pour her heart out, someone on whom she can rely.
But now...
The Kjeragandr scriptures lie open on the desk. The dressing mirror reflects the girl's helpless expression.

spans.text: scriptures lie open on the desk. The dressing mirror reflects the girl's helpless expression.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjarr...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You promised me you wouldn't disappear so suddenly...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Exactly... what happened?
